Earth textures for the Weather Explorer globe. Equirectangular 4096 × 2048 (EPSG:4326, -180..180, -90..90),
retrieved from NASA's Global Imagery Browse Services (GIBS) WMS. NASA imagery is in the public domain.

- blue-marble-4096.jpg — Blue Marble: Shaded Relief and Bathymetry (day side). A static, cloud-free
  composite, not current conditions; weather layers are drawn on top of it.
- black-marble-4096.jpg — VIIRS Black Marble 2016 (night side: city lights). An annual composite of
  night lights, not tonight's conditions.

Acknowledgment: "We acknowledge the use of imagery provided by services from NASA's Global Imagery Browse
Services (GIBS), part of NASA's Earth Science Data and Information System (ESDIS)."
Rebuild with tools/build_globe_texture.py
